## 2.0 兼容性修订版

**FlowEncode 2.0.3 接替 2.0.2，作为 2.0 系列最终维护版本，继续支持旧版 deew 3.x / DEE 5.2.1。** 后续开发转向 3.0 与 deew 5.x。

- 固定环境管理中的编码器、FFmpeg、Av1an、Python、VapourSynth 及相关插件到 2.0 兼容基线，避免仅升级外部工具后导致旧主程序无法使用。
- 安装、更新和修复均使用同一基线；已手动更换版本的环境会显示兼容提示。
- 保留 2.0.2 的 DTS:X 音频兼容修复、脚本准备保护及系统 PATH 集成改进。

请先将主程序更新到 2.0.3，再通过环境管理安装兼容工具。主程序无法阻止其他软件、系统包管理器或用户手动覆盖外部工具；需要新工具链时，请升级 FlowEncode。

公开工具可由环境管理安装。deew、Dolby Encoding Engine / DEE 等外部工具仍需用户自行提供并遵守各自许可，不包含在安装包中。

## Final 2.0 Compatibility Maintenance Release

**FlowEncode 2.0.3 supersedes 2.0.2 as the final maintenance release in the 2.0 series, retaining legacy deew 3.x / DEE 5.2.1 support.** Future development moves to 3.0 and deew 5.x.

- Pinned encoders, FFmpeg, Av1an, Python, VapourSynth and related plugins to the 2.0 compatibility baseline, preventing tool updates from silently breaking an older app.
- Installation, updates and repairs use the same baseline. Manually changed versions display a compatibility notice.
- Includes the DTS:X compatibility fix, script preparation safeguards and system PATH integration improvements from 2.0.2.

Update the app to 2.0.3 before installing compatible tools through environment management. External package managers and manual file replacements remain outside the app's control; upgrade FlowEncode when adopting a newer toolchain.

Public tools can be installed through environment management. External tools such as deew and Dolby Encoding Engine / DEE remain user-supplied, subject to their own licenses, and are not bundled.
